moments.action: Lynn stands face to face with Pat in the airport hall, unmoved as he talks. The wider shot adds Grace, who reaches out to shake Lynn's hand; by the last frame Lynn has swept past both of them and out of shot, leaving the pair standing.

Alone, Lynn perches on her suitcase outside the glass doors, back to camera, framed by the doorway. The cut pulls out to the near-empty concourse, shrinking her to one small figure under the departure signs.

Her father walks up to her by the terminal doors. They square off in shot/reverse-shot, he talking with hands on his hips; Lynn's wary glance over her shoulder turns into a tight, cornered stare by the last frame.
Her father keeps speaking, calm and steady. The reverse stays on Lynn, and across the long take her held composure gives way: eyes reddening and brimming, mouth tightening, by the end close to tears.
He steps in and folds Lynn into a hug, his face still over her shoulder. The angle reverses to find her sobbing openly into his chest, both arms clamped around him as he holds her.
